maria (AE): GaleHealth needs an acceptance matrix: sustain 120 qps p99 < 350ms, ability to burst to 800 qps for ~2m, KMS in-path and audit logs. Can we run a reproducible test Thu?

sam (SE): Yes. Plan: 30m soak @120 qps, then 3x 2m microbursts to 800 qps spaced 5m apart. Compare f32 baseline vs 4-bit quant + KV prefix cache. Capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, queue depth, kernel fallbacks, and per-token infra delta.

zoe (ops): I will provision a temp dedicated pool: 4x A100 + 1 standby. Batching target=16, conservative max concurrency. I'll open loadgen access and wire metrics.

sam (SE): Load commands for reproducibility:
```bash
# 30m soak at 120 qps
hey -z 30m -q 120 -c 250 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"<redacted>"}' https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate
# 3 microbursts (2m) to 800 qps
for i in 1 2 3; do hey -z 2m -q 800 -c 1000 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate; sleep 300; done
```

deploy-bot: provision: pool-gale-1943 started, ETA ~10m.

sam (SE): Quick results (post-run): f32 baseline p99 steady ~270ms. Enabling KMS raised p99 to ~320-350ms with occasional spikes. Quantized variant steady p99 ~460ms; during 800 qps bursts quant p99 spiked to ~610ms due to kernel fallback and host queueing. GPU util: ~68% steady -> ~96% peak.

raj (SRE): Traces show concurrent KMS decrypts blocking proxy threads at burst peaks. Short-term mitigations: pre-warm tokens, increase proxy worker threads; cut tail ~8-12ms. Long-term: async decrypt or HSM integration outside hot path.

maria (AE): Sales needs pricing deltas: monthly Dedicated reserved, prorated test window, hosted-burst pricing, and token-cost delta between variants.

sam (SE): Draft pricing (for negotiation): Dedicated 4xA100 pool ~"$9,500/month"; prorated multi-hour test ~"$1,200". Hosted burst charge estimate ~"$0.09/peak-qps-minute" (single 2m 800-qps burst ~ $144). Token cost: baseline effective $0.018/token-equivalent; quant raw saves ~18% -> $0.0147, net ~12% after infra overhead.

raj (SRE): Security questionnaire blockers: HSM requirement, key custody details, audit log retention windows. Proposed canary recipe: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health checks and automatic fallback if p99 > 500ms for 10m.

maria (AE): Next steps: sam to upload a 1-page runbook + CSV/plots, raj to draft security answers and canary recipe, zoe to post infra cost/prorate numbers. I'll schedule a Fri 10am PT handoff with the customer.

sam (SE): Will upload artifacts here. TL;DR numbers: f32 p99 = 270ms; quant steady p99 = 460ms; quant burst p99 = 610ms. Token net savings ~12%.

maria (AE): Thanks team ":thumbsup:". We'll share the acceptance matrix and pricing with GaleHealth and iterate on security Qs.
